title: Timor-Leste joins ASEAN Inter-Parliamentary Assembly
summary: Timor-Leste was added to the Association of Southeast Asian Nations Inter-Parliamentary Assembly as its 11th member parliament on Wednesday, a little more than a year after joining ASEAN.
